pending.title: C. elegans Maintenance on NGM Plates
pending.duration: Media 2 h + 2–3 days drying; routine transfer 15 min
pending.summary: Pour and seed NGM plates with OP50, keep C. elegans stocks by chunking or picking, and rescue contaminated cultures with a hypochlorite egg prep.
